en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a waterfront hotel terrace. The large, multi‑storey building with dormer windows has the sign "HOTEL DE PLASMOLEN" on its facade. In front of the hotel are outdoor café tables and wicker beach chairs along a narrow canal or pond where small wooden boats are moored. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand or sit by the water, and swans swim in the foreground. Tall trees frame the left side of the scene.
